bugs_found: loan_payment formula is incorrect: it multiplies by r twice and omits (1+r)^months, producing far too small payments
transfer uses amount without Decimal normalization, so non-Decimal numeric inputs can raise TypeError or create inconsistent Receipt amounts
fx_convert accepts zero or negative exchange rates, allowing nonsensical zero/negative converted amounts
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when the minimum fee exceeds the amount
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months with int(), which can miscalculate inputs such as 1.9
